job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer (Big Data)
job.pay_full: $122,000 – $207,000 a year base salary (O'Fallon, Missouri), with possible annual bonus or commissions depending on the role

details.about: Mastercard runs a global payments network in more than 200 countries and territories. Its Business Operations (BizOps) team acts as the production-readiness steward for the platform and leads Mastercard's DevOps transformation. This Lead Site Reliability Engineer supports the Data Delivery and Analytics program behind products such as MyMPA and QMR, working with a global team across several time zones.
duties: Take part in and improve the whole service lifecycle, from design through deployment, operation and refinement
Analyse the platform's ITSM activity and feed operational gaps and resiliency concerns back to development teams
Support services before launch with system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews
Monitor availability, latency and overall health of live services
Scale systems through automation and push changes that improve reliability and velocity
Support the CI/CD pipeline with validation and operational gating, and lead DevOps automation and best practices
Practise sustainable incident response and blameless post-mortems, cutting mean time to recover
Share knowledge and mentor junior team members
needs: BS in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding (such as physics or mathematics), or equivalent practical experience
Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline management and software design
Ability to help debug and optimise code and automate routine tasks
Systematic problem solving, strong communication, ownership and drive
Experience handling difficult situations and making decisions with urgency
Interest in designing, analysing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems
Experience working across development, operations and product teams to prioritise needs and build relationships
nice: Experience in one or more of C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins, Maven, Artifactory and Chef, and designing an efficient CI/CD flow from dev to prod
Tech skills named for the team: Unix, shell scripting, SQL, Python, Apache NiFi, Splunk, Dynatrace, Jenkins, Git, XLR
details.benefits: Base salary $122,000 – $207,000 a year in O'Fallon, Missouri; the role may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions. Benefits for full-time employees generally include medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; flexible spending and health savings accounts; 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave; 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 days of vacation and 5 personal days (pro-rated by hire date); 10 paid US holidays; a 401(k) with company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; and eligibility for tuition reimbursement.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 02/10/2027
Mastercard offers accommodations during the application and recruitment process (reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com)
